answer_1.quote: We propose a novel two-stage model for generating high-quality, diverse candidate summaries ... The first model generates K unique content plans ... then ... realizes an abstract given the plan and the document.

answer_2.quote: We compare summaries to references with ROUGE 1/2/L F1 and BERTScore F1.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation study using the Atomic Content Unit (ACU) protocol ... we use MTurk annotators ... ACU and nACU scores are reported.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators extract atomic facts from reference summaries and match them with system summaries, reporting ACU and length‑normalized ACU (nACU) scores.
